input_unit: object crop from KGCV annotated bbox

evaluation_policy.valid: model selection and early stopping only
evaluation_policy.test: single final evaluation after configuration freeze
evaluation_policy.field: separate; no FIELD_VALIDATED claim from KGCV

promotion_policy.REFERENCE_to_REPRODUCED: training run completes reproducibly on frozen snapshot with metric artifacts and config/seed recorded
promotion_policy.REPRODUCED_to_CANDIDATE: future candidate improves baseline on primary metrics without degrading critical class behavior
promotion_policy.VALIDATED: requires fixed test evaluation under MODEL_ACCEPTANCE_POLICY

known_limitations: Maturity 2 and 3 are absent from snapshot v001 because KGCV turning-red boundary is unresolved
external KGCV domain only; no Nongtori field images included
overripe is mapped to maturity 4 and Grade JM but grade is not the target of this baseline
